scale.likelihood: 1 rare to 4 likely within a year
scale.impact: 1 minor to 4 severe (payroll stops, client data exposed, regulator involved)
scale.rating: Likelihood x impact: Critical 12 or more, High 8 to 11, Medium 4 to 7, Low under 4

risks.title: A spoofed bank-detail change redirects a client payroll payment
risks.description: Business email compromise is the top loss for payroll firms. Treatment: the callback procedure with two approvers (CTL-08), DMARC enforcement and phishing filtering.

risks.title: A payroll specialist's mailbox is taken over before MFA is registered
risks.description: Five accounts have no second factor: three new hires inside their first week and two shared mailboxes that should be sign-in blocked.

risks.title: Client payroll files reachable through anyone-with-the-link sharing
risks.description: Anyone links are allowed without expiry. Change scheduled for Nov 8: expire after 30 days, then restrict to existing guests.

risks.title: Company mail forwarded automatically to a personal mailbox
risks.description: One inbox rule copies mail to a personal Gmail address and the tenant still allows outbound forwarding. Rule removed Oct 31; the tenant setting is due Nov 7.

risks.title: The Brightfile portal breach exposes client documents
risks.description: Brightfile reported unauthorized access to a support system. Awaiting its incident report; the breach notification procedure is on standby.

risks.title: Client files shared through personal Dropbox accounts
risks.description: Six staff connected personal Dropbox accounts. Decision due: approve a business account with a DPA, or block and move the files to SharePoint.

risks.title: Staff paste client personal data into unapproved AI tools
risks.description: Eleven AI tools found in use. Treatment: the AI Acceptable Use Policy, the 15-minute course, approved tools with rules, blocked tools at sign-in.

risks.title: An automation agent reads the payroll inbox beyond its purpose
risks.description: Zapier Agents can read the whole payroll@ mailbox. Treatment under review: a scoped mailbox, an action log and a DPA addendum before approval.

risks.title: Ransomware on the file store with backups that cannot be restored
risks.description: EDR on 54 of 55 devices and immutable backups restore-tested in September reduce both likelihood and impact.

risks.title: The incident response plan has not been exercised in 14 months
risks.description: Last tabletop August 2025. The 2026 exercise (a payroll-day outage plus a BEC attempt) is scheduled for Nov 20 with the IT provider and counsel.

risks.title: Loss of the IT provider's account lead delays incident handling
risks.description: Bay State names a second engineer in the contract; accepted with that cover.

risks.title: Paper payroll records in the Quincy office are not shredded on schedule
risks.description: The retention schedule is unapproved and the office manager role is open, so the shredding cadence has no owner.

risks.title: The Massachusetts written information security program is not documented as 201 CMR 17.00 expects
risks.description: Massachusetts requires a written program for businesses holding residents' personal information. The policy set covers it; counsel is assembling the single document that points to it.
